clarification_of_parent_audit.interpretation: Any wording about correct absence in the parent audit means an empty output relative to the eligible declared event set only. It does not establish physical absence for bandwidth-loss modulation, which is excluded/unobserved. This companion is the authoritative interpretation for that distinction.

presentation_guidance_from_root.blank: Preserve existing schema-valid-empty-report display; requires not schema_failed AND reported_component_count==0. This is a zero-waveform condition.
presentation_guidance_from_root.nonblank_with_saved_reference_event_coun: Mark recovery N/A, retain unchanged saved eventF1/counts in the payload, and annotate saved scoped false-positive count. Do not convert it into a silent or empty-report-success condition.
presentation_guidance_from_root.positive_reference_cells: Retain existing eventF1 presentation and scope.
presentation_guidance_from_root.no_new_metrics: The administrative mapping reads saved fields and explains their meaning; scientific aggregation remains on the queued CUDA figure path.

authoritative_fields.required_scoped_gold_count: evaluation/per_episode.jsonl: reference_event_count (optional evaluation_required=false labels excluded by the evaluator).
authoritative_fields.saved_scoped_false_positives: evaluation/per_episode.jsonl: event_metrics/fp (do not substitute reported_component_count, which can include unscored modulation).
authoritative_fields.saved_f1_precision_recall: evaluation/per_episode.jsonl: event_metrics/f1, /precision, /recall; preserve values, including empty-gold F1=0 and undefined null P/R.
authoritative_fields.complete_report_emission: evaluation/per_episode.jsonl: reported_component_count; this covers retained report entries, not just scored ones.
authoritative_fields.scoring_scope: evaluation/per_episode.jsonl: scoring_scope/modulation_exhaustive plus excluded_predictions and scored_prediction_event_ids; sealed_truth/events and unavailable_modulation_events.
authoritative_fields.actual_transformed_rate: episode.json: final_state/sample_rate_hz; input intervention sample_rate parameter is4000 for bandwidth_loss.
authoritative_fields.non_authoritative_inherited_strings: sealed_truth/modulation_evaluation_scope and per_episode/scoring_scope/rule can be stale after blank/bandwidth interventions.
authoritative_fields.non_authoritative_inherited_rate: sealed_truth/sample_rate_hz and manifest sample_rate describe the base generator and can remain16000 after resampling.
